description: Waste, water and wastewater fees of Swiss communes. Official open data where the canton publishes every commune: canton of Zurich (all communes, since 2000: yearly basic fee converted to a 4-room flat and price per 35-litre bag) and Basel-Landschaft (bag price, basic fee per household, water and wastewater per m³). Plus, for about 380 larger communes in every canton, the federal Price Supervisor's yearly water, wastewater and waste fees for three model households (1, 3 and 4 persons), shown with its consent and its source note. CHF incl. VAT. With commune (name, BFS number or postcode): that commune; without: every ZH/BL commune's latest values.
